# Lisbon trip guide: 2027-05-10 – 2027-05-14

Two adults travelling from Helsinki to Lisbon for a relaxed five‑day stay. The budget is mid‑range with a total of **€2500**. Interests are history and street food. Weather information is based on typical conditions for these dates, not a forecast.

## Getting there and back

- All return flights include two personal items per traveller; no checked bags.

## Where to stay

## Day by day
### Day 1 – Mon 2027-05-10: Alfama/Baixa
*Weather:* light rain, 13‑17 °C — **walk 0.7 km**
- **16:10 Arrive in Lisbon** – Flight with SAS; see Getting there and back.
- **17:00 São Jorge Castle** – Historic fortress overlooking the city; human occupation dates back to the 8th century BC and it later served as a royal palace. Hours 09:00‑21:00. ticket price: see the website. [source](https://www.castelodesaojorge.pt/)
- **18:00 Lisbon Cathedral** – The oldest church in Lisbon, founded in 1147 after the reconquest from the Moors; blends Romanesque, Gothic and Baroque elements. Hours 10:00‑18:30. ticket price: see the website. [source](https://www.patriarcado-lisboa.pt/site/index.php?id=10686)
- **19:30 Néctar WineBar** – Mid‑range wine bar; try the codfish dish and a house dessert. Budget mid. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa)

### Day 2 – Tue 2027-05-11: Belém
*Weather:* drizzle, 13‑18 °C — **walk 7.0 km**
- **10:00 Mosteiro dos Jerónimos** – UNESCO‑listed Manueline masterpiece built in the 16th century; founded by King Manuel I to celebrate Vasco da Gama’s voyage. Hours 10:00‑18:30 (May‑Sep). ticket €18. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)
- **12:00 Monument to the Discoveries** – 1960 monument shaped like a caravel prow, commemorating Portugal’s Age of Discovery. Climb the platform for river views. ticket €4. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bel%C3%A9m)
- **12:30 Mercado Oriental** – Street‑food market with Asian stalls; try the small dishes (≈ €3). Budget low. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Baixa)
- **18:30 Dinner near hotel** – Self‑catered, relaxed evening.

### Day 3 – Wed 2027-05-12: Alfama/Restauradores
*Weather:* rain, 13‑19 °C — **walk 0.8 km**
- **10:00 Museu Nacional do Desporto** – Museum chronicling Portuguese sport history; free entry. Hours 10:00‑17:00 (Tu‑Su). [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5068486966)
- **11:30 Monumento aos Restauradores** – Monument commemorating the 1640 Restoration War that ended Spanish rule. ticket price: see the website. [source](https://opentripmap.com/en/card/W663347630)
- **13:00 Cervejaria da Trindade** – Restaurant‑brewery in a former monastery; try the grilled sardines and house‑brew beer. Budget mid. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)
- **15:00 Museu Nacional do Azulejo** – Museum of Portuguese tiles from the 15th century to today, housed in the former Madre de Deus Convent. Indoor, great for rainy weather. ticket price: see the website. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Alfama)
- **19:30 Rosa da Rua Restaurante** – Three‑course dinner mixing Portuguese, Indian and Cape Verdean flavours. Budget mid. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)

### Day 4 – Thu 2027-05-13: Chiado
*Weather:* drizzle, 13‑19 °C — **walk 0.5 km**
- **10:00 Museu Nacional de Arte Contemporânea – Museu do Chiado** – Modern art collection of Portuguese and international works. Hours 10:00‑18:00 (Tu‑Su). ticket price: see the website. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/96321716)
- **13:00 Faca & Garfo** – Cozy spot; try the grilled sardines. Budget mid. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)
- **19:00 Café Buenos Aires** – South‑American grill; sample the steak sandwich. Budget high. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)

### Day 5 – Fri 2027-05-14: Eduardo VII/Parque
*Weather:* overcast, 13‑20 °C — **walk 1.9 km**
- **10:00 Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** – World‑class collection spanning antiquities to modern art, housed in a purpose‑built building. Hours 10:00‑18:00 (Su‑Mo, We‑Fr). ticket price: see the website. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/188143627)
- **12:30 Os Tibetanos** – Vegetarian restaurant; try the tofu noodles. Budget mid. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)
- **16:35 Depart from Lisbon** – Flight with Finnair; see Getting there and back.

## Food to try
- **Caldo verde** – Portuguese soup. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q770977)
- **Pastel de nata** – Portuguese egg tart pastry dusted with cinnamon. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q1421401)
- **Feijoada** – Bean and meat stew popular in Portuguese‑speaking areas. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q878189)
- **Francesinha** – Portuguese sandwich. [source](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q732)
